composition_variation: Create an original high-quality 2D anime illustration of one beautiful 28-year-old adult woman with youthful adult vitality and a mature, self-assured presence. Give her luminous pale-brown eyes, a graceful mature face, a subtle pointed chin, and an intrigued smile. Her blue-violet hair is woven into a long neat braid. She wears an opaque white short-sleeved summer tunic with a modest collar, pale-lilac straight-leg trousers, and low-profile walking shoes. Inside a serene orbital-science museum, she stands beside a tall curved window and holds a folded exhibition leaflet with both hands at waist height. The sheet has no readable text. Outside, show a distant abstract orbital-ring display model against a pale-blue architectural courtyard, keeping the scene everyday and welcoming. Soft white walls, restrained blue lighting, and one rounded bench support a refined lilac, sky-blue, and ivory palette with even face lighting. Use an eye-level camera and a calm three-quarter-length portrait. Place her centrally in the middle and lower frame, entirely inside a narrow phone-safe composition; keep hands close to her torso. Reserve the upper 25% as uncluttered light atmosphere for the lock-screen clock. Natural anatomy, opaque clothing, no text, no logos, no additional people.
